title: Website Security Inclusions Card: Backup, Monitoring, Compliance Scans and Support
content:
The following inclusions of each Harborline SiteGuard tier of Website Security cover website backups, PCI scanning, monitoring, reporting and support handling.

| Inclusion | Essentials | Plus | Pro | Business | Ecommerce | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Website backup storage, GB | 0 | 0 | 0 | 25 | 50 | 100 |
| Website backup frequency | None | None | None | Daily | Daily | Daily |
| Days website backups are kept | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 60 | 90 |
| Quarterly PCI DSS external vulnerability scans by an approved scanning vendor | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Days between PCI scans | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 90 | 90 |
| Certificate expiry and configuration monitoring | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Minutes between uptime checks | 0 | 0 | 5 | 5 | 1 | 1 |
| Security report frequency | Monthly | Monthly | Monthly | Weekly | Weekly | Weekly |
| Security tickets use the priority queue | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Named security analyst assigned | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |

Columns are the tiers Harborline SiteGuard Essentials, Plus, Pro, Business, Ecommerce and Enterprise. A figure of 0 days or 0 minutes means the tier has none of that inclusion: no backups are kept, no PCI scans run, or no uptime checks run.

## Questions answered by the card

- *Which tiers keep website backups?* Harborline SiteGuard Business, Ecommerce and Enterprise, each daily, kept 30, 60 and 90 days respectively with 25, 50 and 100 GB of storage.
- *Which tiers include PCI scanning?* Harborline SiteGuard Ecommerce and Enterprise, every 90 days.
- *Which tier assigns a named analyst?* Harborline SiteGuard Enterprise only.
